6: Ad agnitionem hominum virtus illorum: et dedit hominibus scientiam Altissimus, honorari in mirabilibus suis.
The virtue of these things is come to the knowledge of men, and the meet High hath given knowledge to men, that he may be honoured in his wonders.
7: In his curans mitigabit dolorem: et unguentarius faciet pigmenta suavitatis, et unctiones conficiet sanitatis: et non consummabuntur opera ejus.
By these he shall cure and shall allay their pains, and of these the apothecary shall make sweet confections, and shall make up ointments of health, and of his works there shall be no end.
8: In his curans mitigabit dolorem: et unguentarius faciet pigmenta suavitatis, et unctiones conficiet sanitatis: et non consummabuntur opera ejus.
By these he shall cure and shall allay their pains, and of these the apothecary shall make sweet confections, and shall make up ointments of health, and of his works there shall be no end.
10: Averte a delicto, et dirige manus, et ab omni delicto munda cor tuum.
Turn away from sin and order thy hands aright, and cleanse thy heart from all offence.
11: Da suavitatem et memoriam similaginis, et impingua oblationem, et da locum medico:
Give a sweet savour, and a memorial of fine flour, and make a fat offering, and then give place to the physician.
13: Est enim tempus quando in manus illorum incurras:
For there is a time when thou must fall into their hands:
16: [Fili, in mortuum produc lacrimas, et quasi dira passus incipe plorare: et secundum judicium contege corpus illius, et non despicias sepulturam illius.
My son, shed tears over the dead, and begin to lament as if thou hadst suffered some great harm, and according to judgment cover his body, and neglect not his burial.
20: Ne dederis in tristitia cor tuum, sed repelle eam a te, et memento novissimorum.
Give not up thy heart to sadness, but drive it from thee: and remember the latter end.
21: Noli oblivisci, neque enim est conversio: et huic nihil proderis, et teipsum pessimabis.
Forget it not: for there is no returning, and thou shalt do him no good, and shalt hurt thyself.
22: Memor esto judicii mei: sic enim erit et tuum: mihi heri, et tibi hodie.
Remember my judgment: for also shall be so: yesterday for me, and today for thee.
23: In requie mortui requiescere fac memoriam ejus, et consolare illum in exitu spiritus sui.]
When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest, and comfort him in the departing of his spirit.
